SMN_TRAINER_DESCRIPTION: Raises elemental creatures from a hatchling to a force of nature. Summon them to fight beside you, or bond with them as permanent companions.
SMN_SALAMANDER_1_DESCRIPTION: A palm-sized salamander whose tail smolders when it's excited.
SMN_SALAMANDER_2_DESCRIPTION: Its hide has hardened into cracked embers; every bite leaves a scorch mark.
SMN_SALAMANDER_3_DESCRIPTION: No longer merely fire-touched - it has become fire, given a fighting shape.
SMN_TURTLE_1_DESCRIPTION: A small shelled creature that hums with restless current.
SMN_TURTLE_2_DESCRIPTION: Its shell channels the tide itself; it soaks foes before it strikes.
SMN_TURTLE_3_DESCRIPTION: Water elemental in truth now - the shell was only ever a starting shape.
SMN_SPROUT_1_DESCRIPTION: A single vine with a stubborn will and stubbier thorns.
SMN_SPROUT_2_DESCRIPTION: Grown thick and defensive; its thorns carry a lingering venom now.
SMN_SPROUT_3_DESCRIPTION: A towering bloom of thorn and root that remembers every ally it's lost - and brings them back.
SMN_STONE_FIRE_DESCRIPTION: A warm, glassy stone that never cools. Consumed to complete an advanced fire evolution.
SMN_STONE_WATER_DESCRIPTION: Always faintly damp to the touch. Consumed to complete an advanced water evolution.
SMN_STONE_PLANT_DESCRIPTION: Smells faintly of rain. Consumed to complete an advanced plant evolution.
SMN_FOL_SALAMANDER_SUBTITLE: A loyal ember, always warm to the touch.
SMN_FOL_SALAMANDER_JOIN: The salamander curls up on your shoulder, radiating warmth.
SMN_FOL_SALAMANDER_LEAVE: The salamander slips away into the underbrush.
SMN_FOL_TURTLE_SUBTITLE: Slow to anger, slower to forget a kindness.
SMN_FOL_TURTLE_JOIN: The turtle plants itself firmly at your side.
SMN_FOL_TURTLE_LEAVE: The turtle wanders back toward the nearest water.
SMN_FOL_SPROUT_SUBTITLE: Puts down roots wherever it's welcome.
SMN_FOL_SPROUT_JOIN: The sprout wraps a tendril gently around your wrist.
SMN_FOL_SPROUT_LEAVE: The sprout unroots itself and returns to the wild.
